const Unit: number = 8
const Delta: number = 12
const Padding: number = @Unit + @Delta
module Box(Origin: number, Fail: boolean) {
const Chosen: point = if (@Origin > 0) { coordinate(x: @Origin + 2, y: 7) } else { coordinate(x: 1 / 0, y: 0) }
const Send: point = @Chosen
export point Mark = from(source: @Send)
if (@Fail) {
point Fault = coordinate(x: 1 / 0, y: 0)
}
}
instance One = Box(Origin: 8, Fail: false)
const ExportOne: point = @One::Mark
point UseOne = from(source: @ExportOne)
instance Two = Box(Origin: 33, Fail: false)
const ExportTwo: point = @Two::Mark
point UseTwo = from(source: @ExportTwo)
instance Failed = Box(Origin: 101, Fail: true)
point UseFailed = from(source: @Failed::Mark)
point Independent = coordinate(x: 20, y: -12)
